description: Permissions for Best Photo Picker desktop app. core:default is Tauri v2's documented minimum baseline. The page the shell loads comes from the sidecar at http://127.0.0.1:5001, a remote origin to Tauri, so that origin is named here and the four custom commands (set_app_theme, exit_app, restart_app, open_url) are granted to it explicitly; their allow-* permissions are generated from build.rs.
